acceptedAnswer.text: We understand the time-sensitive nature of real estate transactions. Discounted Roofing Co. strives to schedule pre-purchase roof inspections promptly, often within a few business days of your request, depending on current demand. It is best to contact us as soon as your offer is accepted to secure your preferred inspection time. Our coverage throughout the DFW metroplex, including cities like Denton, Mesquite, and Weatherford, allows for efficient scheduling across the region.
